# Native Binary

**27 case studies**

- [**AGS Aging Cartridge: disassembling version 7.0**](https://github.com/Normmatt/ags_aging) - The project reconstructs AGS Aging Cartridge 7.0 from a user-supplied Game Boy Advance ROM as assembly and C source. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/ags-aging-cartridge-case/)</sub>
- [**cod4map: reconstructing the Call of Duty 4 BSP compiler**](https://github.com/prd0nja/cod4map) - cod4map reconstructs the BSP compiler shipped with the 2007 Call of Duty 4 mod tools from its executable. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/cod4map-reconstruction-case/)</sub>
- [**dargh: reconstructing Dynamic Animation Replacer for Skyrim**](https://github.com/noxsidereum/dargh) - dargh reconstructs the Dynamic Animation Replacer DLL for Skyrim Special Edition in C++ from analysis of versions 1.1.2 and 1.1.3. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/dargh-case/)</sub>
- [**ExCrypt: reconstructing Xbox 360 XeCrypt functions**](https://github.com/emoose/ExCrypt) - ExCrypt reconstructs Xbox 360 XeCrypt functions as a C and C++ replacement for use with existing console code and data. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/excrypt-case/)</sub>
- [**IOReport: investigating and decompiling Apple’s reporting library**](https://github.com/dehydratedpotato/IOReport_decompile) - IOReport decompile investigates Apple’s IOReport dylib, which provides calls for reading system reports and counters. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/ioreport-decompile-case/)</sub>
- [**L1J-Encode-CLI: reconstructed Lineage 1 ServerData codec**](https://github.com/Lan-0v0/L1J-Encode-CLI) - L1J-Encode-CLI reconstructs the Lineage 1 launcher's ServerData encoding as a Python encoder and decoder for IP addresses, ports, and feature flags. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/l1j-encode-cli-case/)</sub>
- [**ndec-re: reconstructing an MS-DOS encryption program**](https://github.com/bereal/ndec-re) - ndec-re investigates an old MS-DOS COM encryption program through debugger-assisted assembly analysis and implements its encryption behavior in Go. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/ndec-re-case/)</sub>
- [**re-sysinternals-suite: rebuilding Sysinternals strings.exe**](https://github.com/cristeigabriela/re-sysinternals-suite) - re-sysinternals-suite records an educational rebuild of the Sysinternals strings.exe executable. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/re-sysinternals-strings-case/)</sub>
- [**RFL: decompiling the Wii Mii library**](https://github.com/koopthekoopa/RFL) - RFL reconstructs the Wii library responsible for handling Miis from an original game image. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/rfl-wii-mii-library-case/)</sub>
- [**SNES Station: reconstructing the PS2 emulator executable**](https://github.com/ReyFxck/SNESstation-Decomp) - SNES Station Decompilation reconstructs the PlayStation 2 SNES Station v0.23 WIP executable through source recovery, historical toolchain matching and image comparison. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/snes-station-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**uniswap-v2-reborn: reconstructing Uniswap v2 from deployed bytecode**](https://github.com/devtechedge/uniswap-v2-reborn) - uniswap-v2-reborn reconstructs Uniswap v2 factory, pair and Router02 behavior from deployed EVM runtime bytecode using REA interface inspection, storage probing and written specifications. <sub>Case study · Mixed workflow · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/uniswap-v2-reborn-case/)</sub>
- [**Watcom C 6.5: reconstructing damaged runtime libraries**](https://github.com/nrnelson/watcom-c-6.5-restoration) - Watcom C 6.5 run-time library restoration rebuilds damaged CLIBS.LIB and CLIBC.LIB from surviving archive modules. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/watcom-c-6-5-restoration-case/)</sub>
- [**Wirenet Reverse Engineering: analysing a Linux trojan**](https://github.com/shxdow/wirenet-analysis) - Wirenet Reverse Engineering investigates the Wirenet Linux trojan through recovered source code and an Italian analysis report. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/wirenet-analysis-case/)</sub>
- [**bcwc\_pcie: auditing the FaceTime HD camera driver against Apple's kext**](https://github.com/unfallenwill/bcwc_pcie) - bcwc\_pcie audits the community FaceTime HD Linux driver against Apple's AppleCameraInterface.kext for Broadcom PCI 14e4:1570 cameras. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/bcwc-pcie-camera-audit-case/)</sub>
- [**FSR 4 INT8: reconstructed GPU passes and comparison harness**](https://github.com/int3rrobang/fsr4-int8-reverse-engineering) - An FSR 4.1.1 INT8 investigation reconstructs the upscaler’s GPU passes in HLSL and compares their outputs with AMD’s compiled kernels through a D3D12 harness. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/fsr4-int8-reconstruction-case/)</sub>
- [**slopgs: reconstructing Microsoft GS Wavetable Synth**](https://github.com/sloptainment/slopgs) - slopgs reconstructs the behavior of the Windows XP SP3 Microsoft GS Wavetable Synth driver in a portable C synthesizer. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/slopgs-case/)</sub>
- [**Surface Pro 11: reconstructing native Linux audio behavior**](https://github.com/geocausa/SP11X1e-audio) - SP11X1e-audio reconstructs Surface Pro 11 speaker and internal microphone behavior on Linux from Windows runtime observations and binary analysis. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/sp11x1e-audio-case/)</sub>
- [**uniq-reconstruction: rebuilding GNU uniq from behavioral probes**](https://github.com/daedalus/uniq-reconstruction) - uniq-reconstruction rebuilds GNU coreutils 9.7 uniq in C from black-box observations of a stripped ELF executable. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/uniq-reconstruction-case/)</sub>
- [**XexTool-RE: reconstructing the Xbox 360 XexTool utility**](https://github.com/mrtitanic777/XexTool-RE) - XexTool-RE reimplements the closed XexTool utility from analysis of its binary and processes Xbox 360 .xex executables. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/xextool-re-case/)</sub>
- [**CPQ IO Scheduler: reconstructing Xiaomi's block scheduler**](https://github.com/Rasenkai/CPQ_IOSched) - CPQ IO Scheduler reconstructs Xiaomi's proprietary cpq.ko Linux block scheduler from a stripped ARM64 kernel module. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/cpq-iosched-case/)</sub>
- [**m0rph: tracing an obfuscated ELF flag checker**](https://github.com/UmbertoDellaMonica/m0rph-CTF-CyberChallenge.IT) - The m0rph investigation examines an obfuscated x86-64 ELF CTF flag checker with readelf, strings, Cutter and Radare2. <sub>Case study · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/m0rph-ctf-analysis-case/)</sub>
- [**Malware Analysis: njRAT and Casdet behavior investigation**](https://github.com/phour44/Malware-Analysis) - A malware investigation examines njRAT and a UPX-packed Casdet executable with PEStudio static triage and ANY.RUN sandbox telemetry, alongside a malicious PDF and benign comparison files. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/malware-analysis-njrat-casdet-case/)</sub>
- [**Woxi: a Wolfram Language interpreter in Rust**](https://github.com/ad-si/Woxi) - The authors describe Woxi as a Rust interpreter for a subset of the Wolfram Language, focused on CLI scripting and Jupyter notebooks. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/woxi-case/)</sub>
- [**OpenBSD netcat: static REA and Ghidra investigation**](https://github.com/NullLabTests/OpenBSD_netcat_REA) - A REA/Ghidra report studies the Ubuntu netcat-openbsd 1.234-1 ELF binary and publishes evidence envelopes, decompiled functions and a function inventory. <sub>Case study · Mixed workflow · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/netcat-openbsd-rea-static-case/)</sub>
- [**Windows loader: static malware analysis with REA and Codex**](https://codegeeksai.github.io/en/blog/static-malware-analysis-rea-codex/) - Fedele Mantuano reports using Codex with REA in an offline Docker lab to statically analyze a public Windows malware sample without executing it. <sub>Case study · Mixed workflow · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/windows-loader-static-analysis-case/)</sub>
- [**Show Your Work: a measured dissection of REA's evidence architecture**](https://no-flag.com/2026/10/18/REA-paper/) - An unofficial field study that reads REA's source and then drives the running server through 1,012 recorded calls across 27 artifact classes, measuring its content-addressed Evidence records, revision-chained unknown ledger, typed refusals, cold starts and response limits. <sub>Case study · Mixed workflow · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/noflag-rea-evidence-architecture-study/)</sub>
- [**DownUnderCTF: masked-squares flag checker**](https://rea.tools/showcase/ctf/) - An official educational challenge investigation connects binary checks to equations and records an original-program validation. <sub>Case study · Official REA · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/rea-ctf-case/)</sub>
